bundle.shortDescription: Multi-model AI desktop client for LINE Desktop MCP
bundle.longDescription: LINE Model Hub — pick any AI provider (MiniMax M3, OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama) and have it drive line-desktop-mcp to read chats, draft, and send on your behalf. Every send requires explicit approval. v0.6.1+ ships line-desktop-mcp bundled inside the installer; no separate clone + npm install required.
